title: ABORTED - City of Kings - Story One - Chapter One - Let's Play
body:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=615ClJ5oqkw

Daniel (@dungeondive) launches a full let's-play of City of Kings — his first of a game made this decade, he jokes, after two earlier attempts at 90s titles — walking through Story One, "First Blood," beginning with Chapter One: Oakwood. He sets the ground rules for solo play: two heroes (Shara and Thraller), two hope, three morale, and a time track that costs the city a hope every time it strikes midnight. Reading every card's flavour text aloud, he praises the writing warmly, then plays out the loop — moving heroes, sending workers to gather ore and fish, exploring face-down tiles, and triggering a kill-quest against the Grimnir. Combat is simple at low levels: whittle a creature's health down before it activates, spend experience to climb the grid-based skill trees, unlock a second worker and gear slots. Characteristically self-deprecating, he warns viewers never to treat his videos as rules tutorials — he's certain he'll make mistakes and invites corrections. The "ABORTED" in the title is the tell: this playthrough would soon be abandoned. But as a first chapter it's an amiable, low-stakes tour of how City of Kings actually plays turn to turn, movement constraints and all.

----

Reading flavour text aloud and cheerfully bracing for corrections — do you enjoy watching someone learn a game in real time, mistakes and all, or do you prefer a polished playthrough that never fumbles a rule?
